body:
Do these changes mean:
1. We don't serialize the light texture anymore? If so, does that mean we have to recreate it at load time?
2. We expose light_textures in the editor?

The light texture was kept for compatibility with older engine versions, it only serialized the first layer of the many ones that new system supports. The textures had to be recombined on load anyway, this doesn't change that behavior.

2. Previously, only the first texture would be displayed in the editor (remanant of the old system).
